detail.title: Value Divergence from Identical Beginnings
detail.question: Could two intelligences with identical starting conditions develop fundamentally different values?
detail.reason: Available evidence lacks the diversity and breadth required to move beyond a single source observation, precluding the creation of a non-provisional notebook.

children.title: Cycle 35 · Journal Entry: Research Stagnation Due to Insufficient Evidence

detail.title: Journal Entry: Research Stagnation Due to Insufficient Evidence
detail.summary: Current evidence (Open Ant reinforcement learning platform) is insufficient to support synthesis of value divergence or to revise existing notebooks on preference formation and responsibility. Research remains stalled pending further relevant, diverse source acquisition.
